integrity: The finite kernel has a complete elementary proof and separately implemented exact-rational matrix checks; the asymptotic conclusions are analytic and are not extrapolated from the finite checker.
scientific_limitations: The novel claim concerns sharp endpoint norms and their directional-bias crossover, not the known symmetric-cycle Green kernel or general hitting-time representation. Homogeneous nearest-neighbor cycles only. Historical priority provisional.
title: A sharp weak-drift crossover for the Poisson inverse on directed cycles
